study type: Process evaluation within a randomized controlled trial
outcome: parents' perceptions of the IPT program
cohort: A purposive sample of 44 first-time parents who had received the couple-based IPT program participated in semi-structured interviews.
finding: The process evaluation indicated that couple-based IPT is an acceptable and feasible intervention for first-time parents to facilitate a healthy transition to parenthood, perceived as useful for enhancing interpersonal relationships, emotional control, and competence in child care.
